summary: The PR addresses the inconsistency in the behavior of `makemigrations --check` but introduces a behavioral regression risk by changing the order of operations.

issues.description: The change moves the `sys.exit(1)` call before writing migration files, which could lead to incorrect behavior if the check fails after some migrations have been written. This is a regression compared to the original behavior.
The help text for the `--check` option could be more precise. It might be clearer to specify that the command will not generate any migration files if the check fails.
